title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: generative-AI skills in Create for GCC and GCC High
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout facts match the roadmap, and Microsoft documentation supports the licensing requirements and governance controls. It distinguishes general Create documentation from confirmed government-cloud availability and leaves the remaining cloud-specific questions open.

claims.claim: Per-user licenses can be assigned at Microsoft 365 admin center > Users > Active users > user > Licenses and Apps > Licenses.
claims.quote: go to the Users > Active users ... Select the row of the user ... select Licenses and Apps ... Expand the Licenses section, select the boxes for the licenses that you want to assign

claims.claim: Set-MgUserLicense -UserId <user-id> -AddLicenses $addLicenses -RemoveLicenses @() assigns user licenses through Microsoft.Graph.Users.Actions.
claims.quote:
Module: Microsoft.Graph.Users.Actions Module
Set-MgUserLicense -UserId '38955658-c844-4f59-9430-6519430ac89b' -AddLicenses $addLicenses -RemoveLicenses @()

claims.claim: The personal-kit policy is at Microsoft 365 Apps admin center > Customization > Policy Management > policy > Start with the basics > Choose the scope > Configure Settings > Restrict brand kit creation.
claims.quote: Customization > Policy Management ... Select an existing tenant-level policy ... Start with the basics ... Choose the scope ... Configure Settings ... Select Restrict brand kit creation.

claims.claim: No API for configuring Restrict brand kit creation is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "Restrict brand kit creation" "API"; "Cloud Policy" "API" "brand"; "officeCloudPolicy" "brand" Microsoft Graph. Opened brand kit governance and Cloud Policy overview; no matching policy-setting operation found.

claims.claim: The official-kit policy is at Microsoft 365 Apps admin center > Customization > Policy Management > policy > Policies > Elevated role for Brand Managers.
claims.quote: Customization > Policy Management ... Select an existing tenant-level policy ... Select the Policies tab ... select Elevated role for Brand Managers.

claims.claim: No API for configuring Elevated role for Brand Managers is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "Restrict brand kit creation" "Elevated role" API PowerShell; "Elevated role for Brand Managers" "PowerShell"; "Cloud Policy" "API" "brand". Opened brand kit governance and Cloud Policy overview; no matching operation found.

claims.where: controls[3].ui; controls[3].api; Why it matters; Governance controls
claims.claim: Microsoft does not document a tenant switch, in UI or API, to configure individual built-in Create features.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Copilot Create individual features admin enable disable default meter government brand kit policy. Opened configure-copilot-admin-center: "Built-in Create features aren't configured individually." No separate Create switch found.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft's government overview says Copilot prompts, responses and generated content stay in the government cloud.
claims.quote: Prompts, responses, and generated content stay in the government cloud.

claims.claim: The Create article describes users starting from a text description or template.
claims.quote: Create in the Microsoft Copilot app helps you quickly make images, banners, videos, posters, and more from a text description or a template.

claims.claim: The Create article does not describe an agent acting on its own.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot Create" "automatically" "admin"; read the full cited Create support article. Its How to use Create steps require the user to select content and enter a description or select a template; no autonomous agent is described.

claims.claim: The sources do not say this release changes existing behavior for users who do not open Create.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot Create" "automatically" "admin"; Microsoft Copilot Create individual features admin enable disable default. Read roadmap, Create article and configure-copilot-admin-center; no change for nonusers stated.

claims.where: Open questions: brand kit policy government-cloud applicability
claims.claim: The brand kit governance page does not mention government clouds or explicitly confirm both policies for GCC and GCC High.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot" "brand kit" "GCC High" policies; "Create" "Copilot" "GCC" "brand kit". Read full brand kit governance and Cloud Policy overview. The former names no government cloud; the latter establishes portal access, not these policies' availability.

claims.claim: A Create-specific credit rate or meter for government clouds remains unconfirmed.
claims.quote: Searched: "Create" "Copilot" "meter" government licensing. Read Create support article, Copilot service description and License options search excerpts; they name licensing, not a government Create-specific meter or rate.

claims.claim: The cited documentation does not resolve Create video availability in GCC and GCC High.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot Create" "GCC High" video Clipchamp. Read Create article, service description and Clipchamp search excerpts. General Create availability and Clipchamp homepage endpoints do not establish Create video availability in those clouds.
